channel.title: Peptides Weekly
channel.description:
What peptides are, what the evidence actually shows, and what is approved, investigational or unregulated. Every Thursday: the week in peptide science and regulation, and one peptide explained properly — mechanism, studies, status, risks. Education only; never dosing, sourcing or protocols, and never medical advice.

item.title: Ep 6: Thirty-nine percent of GLP-1 users reported nail detachment, versus nine percent of controls.
item.description: Peptides Weekly Thirty-nine percent of GLP-1 users reported nail detachment, versus nine percent of controls. What You Need to Know: In a cross-sectional comparison presented at a dermatology congress, thirty-nine percent of GLP-1 users reported nail detachment, versus nine percent of people who had never taken the drugs. A separate surgical-record analysis linked the same drug class to slightly lower odds of combined heart and infection problems after planned operations. ... item.description: Peptides Weekly Nail detachment was over four times more common in people using GLP-1 drugs. What You Need to Know: A controlled study found nail detachment more than four times as often among people using GLP-1 drugs. item.title: Ep 2: Nearly one in six children taking GLP-1 drugs show nutritional deficiencies in a new study.
item.description: Peptides Weekly Nearly one in six children taking GLP-1 drugs show nutritional deficiencies in a new study. What You Need to Know: A retrospective analysis found nutritional deficiencies in almost 17 percent of children prescribed GLP-1 receptor agonists for weight loss or diabetes. The finding comes from claims data and highlights a measurable gap in monitoring for younger patients. ...
